Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 016. 不含重复字符的最长子字符串

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {
        bool ss[128] = {false};
        int n = s.size();
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            while (ss[s[i]]) {
                ss[s[j++]] = false;
            }
            ss[s[i]] = true;
            ans = max(ans, i - j + 1);
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
